Every 2026 prediction is walk-forward: the model scoring a bet was trained and calibrated only on games settled before that date. Mar 26 – May 31 was the adaptation window; Jun 1 – Jul 10 was the one-shot final gate.

Every 2026 prop with model & market view (4,144 pitcher-game-lines)

Signal = OVER when model P(over) exceeds the opening consensus by ≥ 8pp, UNDER when it falls short by ≥ 8pp, — otherwise. The bet ledger differs slightly: it keeps only the max-edge line per pitcher-game and requires a postable price on the chosen side.
